about.en: PAID is the token of UsePaid, a token-launch service that routes each launched coin's creator fees to the X (Twitter) account it was launched for; part of the protocol's fees is spent buying PAID. It is an SPL token on Solana with mint 98kfF7rmsg1QDUEoCqNE7g7M1FdrTt92TEp2CLzypump, and is unrelated to PAID Network's older PAID token.
